title: trust anchor validity not checked
description: build_chain() terminates when a cert's issuer DN matches an anchor subject, but does not verify the anchor's validity period. The old code called check_validity() on trust anchors; the new pkix-chain delegation omits anchor-validity checking entirely if pkix-chain's DefaultVerifier skips it. An expired trust anchor will silently validate a chain.
close_reason: RFC 5280 does not require validity checking for trust anchors. pkix-chain behavior is correct. Opinion.
